threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for directions to the nearest Tube and get a blank stare—it's all buses and Overground round here, mate.
Last night, a guy serenaded the whole bus with classic Queen, and somehow everyone joined in. Best 15 minutes I’ve had on the N75.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids making a mini-water park out of the fountain in the park, laughing like the world was theirs. Just felt so Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a karaoke bar tucked in a laundromat, where you can belt out 90s hits while waiting for your spin cycle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know you’re local when you can spot a tourist by how they look at a BART delay like it’s an alien invasion instead of just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy juggling while waiting for the 49 at Ellis. He managed to keep it up for a solid five minutes before the bus finally arrived.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just hop on Rodalies anytime, not knowing about the constant strikes. The locals have a backup plan, but they seem lost without their Google Maps.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always insist on asking for a ‘café con leche’ instead of just a ‘café’. Locals know it’s just coffee here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look for a quiet spot in Dalston when every café’s crammed with noise. Locals know the best hideouts by heart.
Caught a bus from Brixton to Clapham last night. Two blokes argued over a broken seat, then bonded over how ridiculous the Tube strikes are. Typical night!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a kid selling homemade lemonade at 10 pm next to the kebab shop. That's Neukölln for you—unexpected and vibrant.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a Spätkauf that doubles as an art gallery with local artists' work on the fridge doors. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Real locals know to time their burrito runs with BART’s inevitable delays; work folks just complain about the wait without a plan.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton last week, bus driver stopped mid-route for a street performer’s solo. Only in SF does the commute pause for art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always ask for paella at local bars. The real deal here is the calçots in season; skip the rice and embrace the onions.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered expressions when they can't find a taxi at 3 AM. Locals just know the night buses run.
